name: The Whole Audience Laughs
flavor: You deliver the biggest punchline of the show, and it lands on everyone at once. Nobody in the audience gets to not laugh.
description: You deliver the biggest punchline of the show and it lands on the whole room at once. It does two things at the same time, listed below — and the half aimed at your own company always works, whatever is standing on the other side of the room.
narration: You have been setting this up since the first round and everybody feels it arrive. Half the room goes down clutching its ribs; the other half — yours — straightens up, stops being afraid of anything, and gets back to work.
sheetSummary: Once per combat. Action, 60 ft, costs 5 Mirth. Two simultaneous effects, listed below: a Wisdom save or helpless laughter on creatures of your choice, and temporary hit points plus condition removal for your allies. The ally half always works.

options.name: Helpless laughter
options.effect: Each creature of your choice that you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw against your {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}. On a failure it falls prone and is incapacitated with helpless laughter for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, and whenever it takes damage, an affected creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature immune to being charmed automatically succeeds, and a creature that cannot hear or cannot understand you is unaffected.

options.name: The room is on your side
options.effect: Each ally you can see within range gains temporary hit points equal to your Jester level, and immediately ends any frightened or charmed condition affecting it. This half never calls for a saving throw and is never blocked by anything on the far side of the fight — constructs and undead cannot laugh, but your friends still can.
